size_basis: Existing Phase28 source-derived target sizes: pointer8,uint32/BodyID4,Step7344,BodyPair8,ContactConstraintMax744,CCDBody160. Conditional LinkValidation two uint32=8; IslandStats three atomic<uint64> plus 3 bytes, x64 aligned32. Current compiled sizes and enabled macros MUST be verified before any runtime; source arithmetic is not target proof.
method: Conservative sum of all aligned positive sites, including temporaries that do not coexist. I<=6 allows disconnected/degraded assembly. Actual occupancy/calls/releases must still be observed, not inferred from spare capacity.
obligations: Existing 32MiB capacity unchanged; no heap fallback/growth/new allocator.
Every positive reservation matched by pointer/request size release; correct LIFO and lifetime; end-of-Update usage zero; bounded peak, no leak, double release, stale worker or buffer overflow.

Record all5 JPH callbacks plus relevant global new/site attribution on every steady tick, including wake and graph/filter work. Zero incremental joint-induced heap calls and bytes; unrelated calls need source and runtime causal proof.
Bind per-target Debug/Release ABI, flags and sources; additional live body/joint/listener/softbody or allocation site invalidates this bound before qualification.
Allocator costs stay in inclusive Physics CPU; separate construction capacities/bytes and teardown.
observation_reuse: Reuse existing GENGINE_PHASE28_QUALIFICATION / GENGINE_JOLT_FINAL_AUDIT observation ABI consistently across affected targets. New GENGINE_PHASE29_QUALIFICATION selects only the Phase29 runner; within approved RBS app/Frame paths exclude old auto-run dispatch when that selector is present. Do not modify SDK/PhysicsSystem/JoltBackend or reinterpret old results. Freeze actual target macro/ABI closure and compiled sizes before runtime; reuse matching archives when identities match.
applies_only: Named six-body/five-joint Phase29 physical workloads and bounded creation/deletion variants; not Native, other scenes, extra ragdolls or later phases.
